title: Quality & Product Development Manager
description:
\*Hiring Quality \& Product Development Manager\* Location \- \*Dhulagar, Howrah\* Salary\- \*60k to 70k\* \*Education Qualification\-\* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical. Experience \- \*10 to 12 years in wire, cable, electrical conductor or similar manufacturing industry.\* \*Key Job Responsibilities:\* Lead Quality Assurance, Quality Control and Product Development activities for enameled copper and aluminium winding wires. Ensure products meet customer specifications, applicable standards and quality requirements.  Ensure reduction in quality complaints by effective handling and coordination with Marketing and Production Department.  Develop and improve products/processes based on customer requirements and market needs.  Ensure quality check of all incoming/Process/Outgoing material to ensure required specification.  Manage ISO 9001:2015 \& IATF 16949:2016 Quality Management System, including audits, documentation, CAPA, and continual improvement.  Coordination, Implementation and total compliance for customers audit in order to fulfill their requirements.  Drive root\-cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and reduction of defects and customer complaints.  Coordinate with Production, R\&D, Sales, and Customers for quality and product\-related issues.  Establish and monitor quality parameters, testing procedures, and process controls.  Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and customer\-specific requirements. Computer Skills: \*Microsoft Office.\*

Pay: ₹65,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: On the road

title: Provisional Distribution Manager
description:
1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Source and identify potential candidates.
* Conduct initial screening and interviews.
* Build a strong pipeline of quality candidates.
* Coordinate the recruitment and selection process.

2\. Team Formation

* Recruit and develop a dedicated team of Insurance Advisors.
* Expand the distribution network through continuous hiring.
* Support team members during the onboarding process.

3\. Training \& Onboarding

* Ensure smooth onboarding of new recruits.
* Provide product knowledge and business orientation.
* Guide team members on company policies and compliance.

4\. Team Management \& Leadership

* Lead, motivate, and mentor the distribution team.
* Monitor individual and team performance.
* Help the team achieve monthly business targets.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.

5\. Business Development

* Generate new business opportunities.
* Build and maintain customer relationships.
* Support business growth through effective distribution management.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
